title: Q3 operator-evaluation map contract and coefficient-only non-implication
question: Does the weighted coefficient norm control an actual Q3 operator history only after an explicit common-core evaluation contract, and can the coefficient data alone supply that contract?
method: State a common-core, submultiplicative-seminorm, generator-radius, linearity and multiplicativity contract that implies coefficient evaluation and product bounds.

Rebuild the actual EXP-001050 Q3 source polynomial in primary SymPy and independent Fraction lanes, evaluate both orientations at all eight sign points of their declared radii, and check product lengths one through four.
Evaluate the same polynomial at a declared radius-violating point and compile Lean R233 for an exact bounded value, product positivity, the obstruction inequality and the scope firewall.
finding: Under the explicit evaluation contract, the two orientation coefficient norms B=1382807/7168 give finite bounded evaluations and the conditional B^n product envelope. The point (q,v,a)=(32,0,1/4) has value 84794793/7168>B and violates |q|<=4, so coefficient data without an explicit generator/map bound is insufficient. This witness is abstract and is not identified with the physical Q3 representation.
decision_reason: This is the direct next gate after EXP-001050: it separates the formal coefficient algebra from the missing Q3 operator realization and gives a precise sufficient admission contract rather than silently assuming one. The finite witness prevents the coefficient-only shortcut while preserving the actual Q3 route.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional QFT interface. It does not construct the actual Q3 common core, close unbounded domains, supply factorial spatial incidence, or establish a thermodynamic QFT.

adversarial_review.check: The weighted l1 norm is used only through an explicit evaluation contract and is not silently identified with an unbounded operator norm.
Invariance and product closure of the common core are hypotheses; the finite sign fixture does not prove them.
Center and source-at-neighbor orientations use separate radii and independent rate/evaluation checks.
The radius-violating witness rejects only the missing generator/map bound and is not identified with physical Q3 operators.
The product consequence uses submultiplicativity only after multiplicativity is assumed; factorial incidence and paths remain open.
R233 checks exact rational fixtures and scope markers, not unbounded domains or Q3 dynamics.
No KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure is inferred.
No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A precise conditional Q3 coefficient-to-operator admission contract, finite bounded orientation evaluations and a finite B^n product consequence.
qft_interface.open: The actual common-core realization, domain invariance, factorial incidence, spatial first passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

next_action: Construct the actual Q3 common-core evaluation map or prove a Q3-specific domain/energy estimate that verifies the contract, then independently audit the factorial spatial incidence bound.
